verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes access requirements for servicing internal plumbing, motors, and electronics during maintenance, adjustment, or replacement.
Target-specific implementation claim: removable top and bottom panels and openable motor towers provide internal service access.
The client adds a concrete acceptance condition that the underside remain accessible and serviceable for future maintenance; no prior value becomes obsolete.
The client extends component maintenance and replacement access into the prospective food-service operating context; no value attribute is removed or replaced.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Hey [CLIENT_NAME_001]. I'm glad you're pleased with the progress overall. My goal is to finish everything, including testing, this week so we can finally get the machine into your hands for use. The present design provides access to every internal component, which should make cleaning straightforward. There is also enough space to install a splash guard if one proves necessary, but we'll find out whether it is needed later this week as the build moves further along.

execution.observed_behavior: After the client specified underside serviceability, the freelancer reports that the present design provides access to every internal component.
